{{Top|leg}}
An '''atmospheric reprocessor''' was part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] life support system. The reprocessors scrubbed the dust and grit from air before running them through cylinders of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] to reoxygenate the [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]] waste.
